description: mix defk.stability.freeze <version> also writes test/stability/<version>/api.exs: the public modules and their documented macros and functions with arities from Code.fetch_docs/1 on the modules compiled at the tag (the tag checked out in a temporary worktree, compiled with mix in :test, docs read from its beams), minus @doc false and the unstable tier, which becomes a list in code (lib or the task) that the stability guide's 'What it does not cover' is checked against; plus the generated functions, the use Defk options, the kernel option, the config key and the env vars, which the task takes from one place in code rather than a hand-written list. Rerun for 0.1.0 it must reproduce the committed api.exs byte for byte (adjust the committed file's formatting only if the task's output differs in comments, never in content; say so in the PR). Done when the release step in docs/agents/stability.md is one command for kernels, rejections and the API snapshot, and mix ci passes.

Awaiting review and merge; ticket stays in progress.

title: Stability: the freeze task writes the API snapshot from the tag
